import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingWitnessBound.lean').read_text().replace(', Nat.add_comm 1 r] ','] ').replace('Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm 1 r]','Nat.add_assoc]')
s=s.replace('theorem factorial_power_lower','''theorem nat_term_le_sum {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ)
    (i : α) (hi : i ∈ s) : f i ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, f j := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact False.elim (Finset.notMem_empty i hi)
  | @insert j s hj ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hj]
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
    · exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
    · exact (ih hi).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

theorem nat_prod_mono {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f g : α → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i) : (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, g i := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert j s hj ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hj, Finset.prod_insert hj]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (h j (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih (fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))

theorem factorial_power_lower''')
s=s.replace('Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ c)','nat_term_le_sum Finset.univ (fun c => (witnessDomain w c).card) c (Finset.mem_univ c)').replace('Finset.prod_le_prod each','nat_prod_mono Finset.univ _ _ each')
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingWitnessBound.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
